AboutUs.title: KRONOS LOGISTICS
AboutUs.subtitle: Global Logistics You Can Count On.
AboutUs.description: Kronos Logistics is a global supply chain partner trusted by industries where precision cannot be compromised. Your supply chain deserves precise solutions engineered for reliability, speed, and cost efficiency — and that’s exactly what we deliver, anywhere in the world. We secure every link in your supply chain with certified customs specialists managing clearance across borders worldwide, and a single point of contact who delivers exactly the level of control your operation needs — whether that means moving your cargo directly, orchestrating an entire network of providers, or both. One global partner. Every solution. Total security, end to end.
AboutUs.col1Text: We manage transportation, warehousing, and customs services directly — a single, accountable partner handling your physical supply chain end to end, backed by certified specialists and real-time tracking through the Kronos App.
AboutUs.col2Text: When your logistics network spans multiple carriers, warehouses, and providers across borders and continents, Kronos becomes the central point of control — coordinating your full network, including providers outside our own fleet, under one unified strategy.

4pl-logistics.metaDesc: Kronos Logistics offers tailored 4PL Logistics solutions, integrating warehousing, transportation, and inventory management to optimize your supply chain and reduce costs.
4pl-logistics.intro: A dedicated partner for your supply chain, not merely a provider. As your fourth-party logistics (4PL) partner, KRONOS assumes full ownership of your logistics operation — transportation, warehousing, and customs — orchestrated as a single, seamless system spanning an international network of partners, ports, and gateways. Every shipment is engineered with precision, security, and visibility, powered by an integrated technology platform and overseen by specialists in supply chain and customs management who anticipate complexity before it becomes a delay.

advantages.title: Global Reach, Local Execution
advantages.desc: Operating across borders and markets through an established international network, moving your cargo wherever your business takes you.

advantages.title: Secure, Reliable Movement
advantages.desc: Cargo is safeguarded and monitored from origin to final destination, minimizing risk at every point of the journey.

advantages.title: Technology-Driven Visibility
advantages.desc: A fully integrated digital platform delivers real-time tracking and data across every stage of your supply chain, with nothing left to guesswork.

advantages.title: Expert Hands, Every Step
advantages.desc: Supply chain and customs specialists oversee every movement, navigating regulatory complexity to keep your cargo flowing without interruption.

advantages.title: Capital Preserved
advantages.desc: Your resources remain invested in your core business, not in warehouses, fleets, or infrastructure.

advantages.title: Continuous Refinement
advantages.desc: Your supply chain evolves through deliberate, data-informed adjustments, never a standard template.

advantages.title: One Relationship, Complete Accountability
advantages.desc: A single point of contact at KRONOS orchestrates every moving part, with nothing left to interpretation.

air-freight.metaDesc: Kronos Logistics offers fast, secure, and reliable air freight shipping services worldwide. We analyze your cargo size and budget to deliver cost-effective logistics solutions.
air-freight.intro: When speed determines outcome, KRONOS delivers air freight engineered for security and reliability, supported by technology that ensures complete traceability from origin to destination. Our expertise spans the automotive, technology, and aerospace industries, where critical, fragile cargo demands a standard of precision beyond conventional air transport.

advantages.title: Speed without compromise
advantages.desc: the fastest mode available, compressing transit times that ground or ocean freight cannot match.

advantages.title: Reliable, on schedule
advantages.desc: consistent on-time performance and dependable transit times across every service tier, shipment after shipment.

advantages.title: End-to-end traceability
advantages.desc: an integrated technology platform monitors every shipment in real time, ensuring full visibility from origin to final destination.

advantages.title: Secure by design
advantages.desc: rigorous security protocols and minimized handling reduce exposure to loss, damage, or compromise throughout the supply chain.

advantages.title: Cargo insurance, on demand
advantages.desc: optional coverage protecting the full value of your shipment throughout transit.

advantages.title: Built for critical cargo
advantages.desc: specialized handling for the automotive, technology, and aerospace industries, where fragile and high-value materials require precision at every stage.

advantages.title: Global network, local execution
advantages.desc: domestic agents combined with direct access to the world’s highest-traffic airports, ensuring consistent execution across every market we serve.

advantages.title: Customs guidance, origin to destination
advantages.desc: dedicated advisory governing every regulatory requirement across the journey.

included.title: Economy
included.desc: cost-efficient air transport for shipments where flexible timelines allow for greater savings.

included.title: Priority Freight
included.desc: expedited handling and reduced transit times for shipments where schedule certainty is critical.

included.title: Next Flight Out (NFO)
included.desc: the fastest possible dispatch, placing time-critical cargo on the next available flight.

bonded-carrier.metaDesc: Kronos Logistics provides licensed Bonded Carrier services, allowing you to move freight through U.S. points of entry safely and efficiently without immediate duty payments.
bonded-carrier.intro: Move your freight through U.S. ports, border crossings, and FTZ warehouses — without paying duties or taxes upfront. Available by ground, air, and ocean transport, Kronos keeps your cargo compliant and your capital working for your business, with a fully auditable chain of custody from origin to final delivery.
bonded-carrier.advantagesTitle: Why Bonded Carrier Works for You

advantages.title: Defer duty and tax payments
advantages.desc: Improve cash flow by paying only when goods formally enter U.S. commerce, not before.

advantages.title: Ground, air, and ocean bonded transport
advantages.desc: Move freight by truck across border crossings, by air through bonded warehouse facilities at major airports, or by sea through bonded terminals at major U.S. ports — whichever mode your cargo demands.

advantages.title: Long-term, flexible storage
advantages.desc: Keep inventory in bond for as long as your strategy requires, with no forced deadlines.

advantages.title: Product integrity protected
advantages.desc: Climate-controlled, monitored facilities preserve cargo quality and condition throughout storage.

advantages.title: Full chain-of-custody compliance
advantages.desc: Every movement documented and audit-ready, built for the standards that regulated industries demand.

bonded-carrier.heroSubtitle: Move Freely. Delay Duties. Stay Compliant.

full-truckload-ftl.metaDesc: Kronos Logistics provides reliable and professional USMCA Full Truckload (FTL) shipping solutions. We offer dry van, temperature controlled, oversized, and flatbed transportation.
full-truckload-ftl.intro: Move full truckload freight seamlessly across Mexico, the United States, and Canada under the USMCA trade agreement — with the speed your just-in-time operation demands and the compliance your supply chain requires. Kronos combines C-TPAT certified cross-border expertise with a dedicated carrier network, powered by Samsara technology and the Kronos Client App, to keep your freight moving without delay at every border crossing.
full-truckload-ftl.advantagesTitle: Why USMCA FTL Works for You:

advantages.title: Tri-national coverage
advantages.desc: Direct full truckload service across Mexico, the U.S., and Canada, all under one carrier relationship and one point of contact.

advantages.title: Built for just-in-time delivery
advantages.desc: Optimized border-crossing routes and dedicated capacity keep your production lines running without costly downtime.

advantages.title: C-TPAT certified security
advantages.desc: Recognized by U.S. Customs and Border Protection as a trusted, low-risk partner — meaning faster clearance and fewer inspections at every crossing.

advantages.title: Samsara-powered fleet visibility
advantages.desc: Live GPS tracking, ELD compliance, and predictive ETAs across every load, giving you precision visibility from pickup to delivery.

advantages.title: Real-time shipment tracking via the Kronos Client App
advantages.desc: Monitor border-crossing status, documentation, and delivery milestones from your phone, anywhere in the world.

advantages.title: USMCA-compliant documentation
advantages.desc: Certificates of origin and customs paperwork handled end-to-end, reducing delays at every checkpoint.

advantages.title: Dedicated cross-border carriers
advantages.desc: A vetted network with deep experience at Laredo, El Paso, Port Huron, Windsor, and other major USMCA crossings.

full-truckload-ftl.heroSubtitle: Cross Borders. Stay on Schedule. Keep Production Running.

hand-carrier-service.metaDesc: Kronos Logistics provides high-urgency hand-carrier / onboard courier services. Rest assured that your high-value or critical shipments are under full control, custody, and speed.
intro: Kronos Hand Carrier exists for the cargo that cannot be replaced, cannot be delayed, and cannot be trusted to a warehouse floor. When an assembly line, an aircraft, a defense operation, or a life-saving treatment depends on a single shipment, we put a dedicated courier on the next flight out — your cargo, in hand, anywhere in the world.

This is our highest priority service tier: every Hand Carrier shipment receives priority dispatch, priority routing, and priority handling — secured at every step, cleared at every border, for the industries where failure has no margin.
hand-carrier-service.advantagesTitle: Built for the Industries Where Delay Is Not an Option:

advantages.title: Automotive
advantages.desc: A single missing part can halt an entire assembly line, costing far more per hour than the courier service itself. We get it there first.

advantages.title: Aerospace & Defense
advantages.desc: Flight-critical components and classified materials that can’t sit in a warehouse. Custody that never breaks, clearance that never stalls.

advantages.title: Pharma & Medical
advantages.desc: Surgical equipment and biologics needed at a specific location, on a tight timeline. When a patient is waiting, so are we — already in the air.

advantages.title: High-Tech & Semiconductors
advantages.desc: Prototype components and sensitive electronics that demand hand-to-hand custody. Nothing irreplaceable ever touches a cargo hold.

included.title: Priority service, every time
included.desc: Hand Carrier shipments are dispatched first, routed first, and cleared first. Your cargo is never queued behind standard freight.

included.title: Global Coverage. One Courier Away.
included.desc: Direct, worldwide courier coverage reaching every major international hub, on every continent — wherever your operation runs, we are already positioned to respond.

included.title: Response measured in hours, not days
included.desc: A dedicated courier is dispatched and airborne within hours of your call. In your industry, time is not a convenience — it is the cost of doing business.

included.title: Dedicated customs advisory
included.desc: A Kronos customs specialist manages your clearance strategy in advance and travels the process in person with your courier — turning a multi-day customs procedure into a matter of minutes at every checkpoint, even for controlled and regulated cargo.

included.title: Live tracking on the Kronos App
included.desc: Follow your courier’s exact location and every milestone in real time, from pickup to final delivery.

hand-carrier-service.outro: When time stands in your way, speed is our solution.

hazmat-logistics.metaDesc: Kronos is fully certified to move dangerous goods by road, air, and sea under DOT, IATA DGR, IMDG, and NOM-002-SCT standards.
intro: Hazardous materials demand zero margin for error. Kronos is fully certified to move dangerous goods by road, air, and sea — under DOT, IATA DGR, IMDG, and NOM-002-SCT standards — with certified specialists managing every checkpoint.
Built for the industries that can’t afford a mistake: chemical, petrochemical, pharmaceutical, energy, and industrial manufacturing.

advantages.title: Certified across every mode
advantages.desc: DOT, IATA DGR, and IMDG certified handling for hazardous materials by road, air, and sea — one partner, every mode of transport.

advantages.title: Full class coverage
advantages.desc: From Class 1 explosives to Class 9 miscellaneous dangerous goods, our certified teams are trained and equipped to handle the full spectrum of hazard classifications.

advantages.title: Cross-border compliance, Mexico and beyond
advantages.desc: NOM-002-SCT certified for Mexican road transport, with federally licensed drivers and valid SCT permits at every crossing.

advantages.title: Documentation that holds up to scrutiny
advantages.desc: Complete emergency response documentation, segregation protocols, and compliance paperwork — audit-ready, every time.

advantages.title: Real-time tracking via the Kronos App
advantages.desc: Monitor your hazmat shipment’s location, compliance status, and milestone progress in real time, from anywhere in the world.

advantages.title: Specialists, not generalists
advantages.desc: Every hazmat shipment is managed by certified specialists who understand the regulatory weight of what they’re moving — not a standard freight team handling an exception.

hazmat-logistics.outro: Safety you can trust. Every shipment, every time.

less-than-truckload-ltl.metaDesc: Kronos Logistics provides flexible and cost-effective USMCA Less Than Truckload (LTL) shipping. Combine your cargo with others to reduce transit costs and increase efficiency.
intro: Move less-than-truckload freight across Mexico, the United States, and Canada — without paying for space you don’t need. Kronos connects you to an extensive network of certified carriers across all three countries, consolidating your shipments onto the most efficient cross-border routes available, with both standard and priority service levels to match your timeline.
This is USMCA LTL built for suppliers who ship often, but not always in full truckloads — cost-efficient, cross-border, and never slower than it needs to be.
less-than-truckload-ltl.advantagesTitle: Why USMCA LTL Works for You:

advantages.title: Multi-carrier network across North America
advantages.desc: Direct access to a broad network of certified LTL carriers throughout Canada, the United States, and Mexico — more routing options, better rates, and more flexibility than a single-carrier service.

advantages.title: Best-in-class transit times
advantages.desc: Optimized cross-border routing and consolidation get your freight moving on the fastest available path, every time.

advantages.title: Standard and Priority service tiers
advantages.desc: Choose standard LTL for routine, cost-driven shipments, or priority service when your timeline can’t flex — same network, same compliance, different speed.

advantages.title: Bonded LTL for hazmat shipments
advantages.desc: Move certified dangerous goods across all three countries without paying duties or taxes upfront, with full DOT, IATA DGR, and IMDG-compliant handling — even when consolidated with other freight.

advantages.title: USMCA-compliant documentation
advantages.desc: Certificates of origin and customs paperwork handled end-to-end for every shipment, regardless of how many other shippers are on the trailer.

advantages.title: Real-time shipment tracking via the Kronos Client App
advantages.desc: Monitor your freight’s location, consolidation status, and border-crossing progress from your phone, anywhere in the world.

advantages.title: Pay only for what you ship
advantages.desc: No dedicated trailer, no wasted capacity — just the space your shipment actually needs, at a cross-border rate built for recurring suppliers.

less-than-truckload-ltl.heroSubtitle: Wider Network. Affordable Rates. Smarter Consolidation.
less-than-truckload-ltl.outro: Fast where it counts. Affordable where it matters.

sea-freight.metaDesc: Kronos Logistics provides high-quality and secure deep sea shipping services, including FCL, LCL, and customs compliance for global import and export.
intro: The ocean is the world’s largest supply chain. Kronos is built to navigate it. We provide global ocean freight through the commercial ports that matter most, connecting every continent under a single trusted partner. From the first container loaded to the last mile delivered, your cargo moves with the compliance, visibility, and precision that high-volume global trade demands.

This is sea freight engineered for scale: automotive components, industrial machinery, chemical compounds, and manufacturing at volume — moved through the ports the world depends on, managed by the partner you can depend on.

advantages.title: Global port coverage, without compromise
advantages.desc: Direct access to the commercial gateways that drive world trade, including major ports across Mexico (Manzanillo, Veracruz, Lázaro Cárdenas), the United States (Los Angeles/Long Beach, Houston, New York/New Jersey), China (Shanghai, Qingdao, Shenzhen), and key hubs throughout Asia, Africa, and Europe.

advantages.title: FCL and LCL, engineered for your volume
advantages.desc: Full container load for shipments at scale, or less-than-container load when precision matters more than volume — both backed by the same uncompromising standard of compliance and visibility.

advantages.title: Customs brokerage, end to end
advantages.desc: One team manages clearance at origin and destination, across every jurisdiction your cargo crosses — so your cargo never waits on paperwork it shouldn’t have to.

advantages.title: Total visibility, ocean to ocean
advantages.desc: Track your container’s location, port status, and estimated arrival in real time through the Kronos Client App.

advantages.title: One contact. Every port. Every time.
advantages.desc: A single point of contact across your entire global ocean network — no fragmented carriers, no dropped handoffs, no surprises at customs.

sea-freight.heroSubtitle: Every Ocean. Every Port. Connected by Kronos.
sea-freight.outro: No borders. No limits. Worldwide reach.

trailer-rental.metaDesc: Kronos Logistics provides flexible dry van and flatbed trailer leasing. Lease short-term or long-term to scale your fleet as needed.
trailer-rental.intro: Scale your capacity on demand — without the capital commitment of owning a fleet. Whether you need a trailer for a single day or a dedicated lease for an extended production cycle, Kronos gives you immediate access to a modern, well-maintained trailer fleet that flexes with your operation, not against it.
trailer-rental.advantagesTitle: Why Kronos Trailer Lease Works for You:

advantages.title: Lower cost, by design
advantages.desc: Access the trailers you need without the capital expense of fleet ownership.

advantages.title: Zero maintenance burden
advantages.desc: No repair costs, no downtime for service — every trailer is maintained and ready before it reaches you.

advantages.title: Flexible yard storage options
advantages.desc: Choose between daily-use leasing or monthly yard storage for trailers you need on standby — pay only for the arrangement that matches how your operation actually runs.

advantages.title: Flexible terms, built around your timeline
advantages.desc: From day-to-day leases to long-term agreements, choose the duration that matches your actual operational need.

trailer-rental.heroSubtitle: The Fleet You Need. Exactly When You Need It.
trailer-rental.outro: Capacity on your terms. Commitment on your schedule.

warehousing.metaDesc: Kronos Logistics offers secure, flexible, and monitored warehousing solutions. Keep your cargo safe at key strategic distribution points.
intro: Supply chains demand flexibility — and the right storage strategy is what makes that flexibility possible. Kronos operates a network of certified, monitored warehousing facilities at strategic hubs, giving your cargo a safe, well-placed waypoint between origin and destination.
This is warehousing built to function as an extension of your business — without the overhead of running it yourself.
warehousing.advantagesTitle: Why Kronos Warehousing Works for You:

advantages.title: Eliminate fixed costs
advantages.desc: No maintenance, no equipment, no additional headcount. Storage costs that scale with your actual need, not a fixed overhead you carry year-round.

advantages.title: Strategic distribution positioning
advantages.desc: Facilities located at key hubs, positioning your inventory exactly where your supply chain needs it most.

advantages.title: Reclaim your own space
advantages.desc: Free up your facility for what matters most to your operation, while Kronos manages the rest.

advantages.title: An extension of your team, not a burden on it
advantages.desc: Scale storage and handling capacity without adding labor, training, or management overhead on your side.

advantages.title: 24/7 monitored security
advantages.desc: Constant surveillance and controlled access keep your cargo protected around the clock, at every facility.

included.title: Packaging
included.desc: Professional packaging to industry and shipment-specific standards.

included.title: Loading & unloading
included.desc: Efficient, damage-free handling at every transfer point.

included.title: Cycle counts
included.desc: Regular inventory verification to keep your records accurate and audit-ready.

included.title: Relabeling
included.desc: Compliant relabeling for changing destinations, regulations, or client requirements.

included.title: Material inspection
included.desc: Quality and condition checks at intake and throughout storage.

warehousing.heroSubtitle: Your Inventory. Strategically Placed. Fully Secured.
warehousing.outro: Space that adapts. Security that scales with you.

ServicesSidebar.title: Need a Solution?
ServicesSidebar.text: Contact our logistics experts today to find the perfect fit for your supply chain requirements.

OurServices.title: OUR SERVICES
OurServices.quote: Reliable Solutions. Global Network. Built on Trust.
OurServices.subtitle: Companies need to be sure that their transportation provider can offer all types of freight management, high quality, personalized and innovative solutions based on their own business needs that's why we provide Global Logistics Services you can count on.

ftl.title: USMCA FTL
ftl.description: We work closely and count with a very large, reliable, and high-quality carrier network to provide professional services and the best affordable rate for all your truckload needs.

ltl.title: USMCA LTL
ltl.description: If you want to reduce your freight costs, LTL (Less Than Truckload) is your best solution. It is ideal when your shipment does not require a dedicated trailer.

air.title: Air Freight
air.description: With our global experience, we provide reliable and efficient air freight services to meet our customers' specific transportation and logistics needs.

hand.title: Hand Carrier Service
hand.description: The hand-carry / onboard courier is characterized by operating in situations of extreme urgency. We assign a dedicated courier to accompany your cargo on board a passenger flight to ensure custody and speed.

sea.title: Sea Freight
sea.description: With the highest quality and security standards, we offer deep sea shipping freight services, import, and export from/to all main ports in the world.

warehousing.title: Warehousing
warehousing.description: We understand that modern industries require high storage flexibility along their logistics chain. That’s why we partner with safe, secure, and reliable warehousing providers.

hazmat.title: Hazmat Logistics
hazmat.description: Kronos is fully certified to move dangerous goods by road, air, and sea under DOT, IATA DGR, IMDG, and NOM-002-SCT standards, with certified specialists managing every checkpoint.

fourpl.title: 4PL Logistics
fourpl.description: As your fourth-party logistics (4PL) partner, KRONOS assumes full ownership of your logistics operation — transportation, warehousing, and customs — orchestrated as a single, seamless system.

bonded.title: Bonded Carrier
bonded.description: Transportation that is licensed to move freight through/across U.S. points of entry without having to pay duties, taxes and/or fees on those goods during transit.

trailer.title: Trailer Lease
trailer.description: Rental gives you the freedom and flexibility to have exactly the trailers you need, whether you are looking for a short-term rental or a lease contract.

GlobalCoverage.title: Global Scope & Connectivity
GlobalCoverage.northAmericaDesc: Key domestic and international FTL/LTL solutions across the US and Mexico.
GlobalCoverage.europeDesc: Import and export management through major maritime and air hubs.
GlobalCoverage.asiaDesc: Seamless supply chain integration for manufacturing and distribution.

Coverage.title: COVERAGE IN MEXICO'S AIR CUSTOMS
Coverage.p1: Kronos Logistics holds full authorization to operate within bonded facilities and customs zones at Mexico’s principal international airports — clearance that opens doors most carriers simply can’t access.
Coverage.p2: Our drivers are extensively trained across general dry cargo and hazardous materials — authorized operators carrying ID badge and ANAM TAG credentials that grant access to the federal zone and enable the clearance and dispatch of import and export shipments without delay.
Coverage.p3: Backed by deep operational experience and advanced tracking technology, every shipment moves with the precision and security your cargo demands.
